column1: # What a viewer got from every route in v0.6.0, frozen. It was produced
# by running this matrix against the v0.6.0 tag, before the developer
# role existed, and is checked in so that enabling another role can be
# proved not to widen this one: nobody gains a power without a role
# change. Do not regenerate it. A new route adds one line here, written
# by hand, saying what a viewer may do with it.
# Columns: route, a viewer with all services, a viewer granted one
# service calling it for that service, the same viewer calling it for a
# service outside the grant. "reach" means the request got past the
# guard to the handler; a number is the status the guard answered.
